title: 广州小微出口信保申领线索
summary_zh: 2026年通知引导辖区内2025年度出口额1000万美元（含）以下的中小微企业通过单一窗口申领普惠平台类出口信保；实际保障仍看保单。
summary_en: The Guangzhou notice encourages eligible local SMEs with 2025 exports no greater than USD 10 million to apply through the Single Window for the inclusive-platform policy. The issued policy determines actual cover.
tradex_workflow: Create a policy-readiness checklist and obtain the actual policy before answering coverage or claim questions.
cash_effect: Do not add an insurance recovery to cash solely because the enterprise fits the notice description.
source_title: 组织中小微出口企业线上申领普惠出口信用保险保单的通知
embedding_text:
广州小微出口信保申领线索
2026年通知引导辖区内2025年度出口额1000万美元（含）以下的中小微企业通过单一窗口申领普惠平台类出口信保；实际保障仍看保单。
The Guangzhou notice encourages eligible local SMEs with 2025 exports no greater than USD 10 million to apply through the Single Window for the inclusive-platform policy. The issued policy determines actual cover.
Keywords: 广州, 小微企业, 出口信用保险, 信保, 普惠, insurance
